answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity’s bonded collateral in escrow and links correlated equivocation across the swarm: when k coordinated identities equivocate, the penalty grows as O(k²), not linearly. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation preventing rapid recovery of slashed stake. Thus identities named zenith, river, or nebula gain no safety from fragmentation; coordination increases the attacker’s aggregate risk.
